WITH cpu_stats AS (
    SELECT server_id,
           AVG(sqlserver_cpu_utilization::numeric) AS avg_cpu_pct,
           MAX(sqlserver_cpu_utilization) AS max_cpu_pct,
           PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sqlserver_cpu_utilization)::numeric
               AS p95_cpu_pct,
           COUNT(*) AS cpu_samples
    FROM collect.v_cpu_utilization_stats
    WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv}) AND collection_time >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '24 hours'
    GROUP BY server_id
),
mem_latest AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (server_id)
           server_id,
           total_server_memory_mb,
           target_server_memory_mb,
           total_physical_memory_mb,
           buffer_pool_mb,
           max_workers_count,
           current_workers_count,
           total_server_memory_mb::numeric / NULLIF(target_server_memory_mb, 0)
               AS memory_ratio
    FROM collect.v_memory_stats
    WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv})
    ORDER BY server_id, collection_time DESC
),
server_info AS (
    /* vcore_count is the licensable number where the platform bills by vCore. */
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (server_id)
           server_id, COALESCE(vcore_count, cpu_count) AS cpu_count
    FROM collect.server_properties
    WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv})
    ORDER BY server_id, collection_time DESC
),
storage AS (
    SELECT server_id,
           SUM(total_size_mb) AS total_mb,
           SUM(CASE WHEN used_size_mb IS NOT NULL
                    THEN total_size_mb - used_size_mb ELSE 0 END) AS free_mb
    FROM collect.v_database_size_stats
    WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv}) AND (server_id, collection_time) IN (SELECT server_id, MAX(collection_time) FROM collect.v_database_size_stats WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv}) GROUP BY server_id)
    GROUP BY server_id
),
budget AS (
    SELECT server_id, COALESCE(monthly_cost_usd, 0)::numeric AS monthly_cost
    FROM config.config_monitored_servers
    WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv})
)
SELECT
    srv.name AS "Server",
    replace(CASE
        WHEN c.avg_cpu_pct < 15 AND c.max_cpu_pct < 40 AND COALESCE(m.memory_ratio, 0) < 0.5
        THEN 'OVER_PROVISIONED'
        WHEN c.p95_cpu_pct > 85 OR COALESCE(m.memory_ratio, 0) > 0.95
        THEN 'UNDER_PROVISIONED'
        ELSE 'RIGHT_SIZED'
    END, '_', ' ') AS "Status",
    trunc((CASE
        WHEN c.p95_cpu_pct <= 70 THEN trunc(100 - c.p95_cpu_pct * 50 / 70.0)
        ELSE trunc(GREATEST(0, 50 - (c.p95_cpu_pct - 70) * 50 / 30.0))
    END) * 0.40 + (CASE
        WHEN CASE WHEN m.total_physical_memory_mb > 0 THEN m.buffer_pool_mb::numeric / m.total_physical_memory_mb ELSE 0 END <= 0.30 THEN 60
        WHEN CASE WHEN m.total_physical_memory_mb > 0 THEN m.buffer_pool_mb::numeric / m.total_physical_memory_mb ELSE 0 END <= 0.85 THEN 100
        WHEN CASE WHEN m.total_physical_memory_mb > 0 THEN m.buffer_pool_mb::numeric / m.total_physical_memory_mb ELSE 0 END <= 0.95 THEN trunc(100 - (CASE WHEN m.total_physical_memory_mb > 0 THEN m.buffer_pool_mb::numeric / m.total_physical_memory_mb ELSE 0 END - 0.85) * 800)
        ELSE trunc(GREATEST(0, 20 - (CASE WHEN m.total_physical_memory_mb > 0 THEN m.buffer_pool_mb::numeric / m.total_physical_memory_mb ELSE 0 END - 0.95) * 400))
    END) * 0.30 + (CASE
        WHEN CASE WHEN COALESCE(st.total_mb, 0) > 0
        THEN st.free_mb * 100.0 / st.total_mb
        ELSE 100 END >= 30 THEN 100
        WHEN CASE WHEN COALESCE(st.total_mb, 0) > 0
        THEN st.free_mb * 100.0 / st.total_mb
        ELSE 100 END >= 10 THEN trunc(50 + (CASE WHEN COALESCE(st.total_mb, 0) > 0
        THEN st.free_mb * 100.0 / st.total_mb
        ELSE 100 END - 10) * 2.5)
        ELSE trunc(CASE WHEN COALESCE(st.total_mb, 0) > 0
        THEN st.free_mb * 100.0 / st.total_mb
        ELSE 100 END * 5)
    END) * 0.30) AS "Health",
    CASE CASE
        WHEN c.avg_cpu_pct < 15 AND c.max_cpu_pct < 40 AND COALESCE(m.memory_ratio, 0) < 0.5
        THEN 'OVER_PROVISIONED'
        WHEN c.p95_cpu_pct > 85 OR COALESCE(m.memory_ratio, 0) > 0.95
        THEN 'UNDER_PROVISIONED'
        ELSE 'RIGHT_SIZED'
    END
        WHEN 'RIGHT_SIZED' THEN
            'CPU is moderately loaded (avg ' || to_char(round((c.avg_cpu_pct)::numeric, 1), 'FM999999990.0') || '%, p95 '
            || to_char(round((c.p95_cpu_pct)::numeric, 1), 'FM999999990.0') || '%) and memory is well-utilized (buffer pool uses '
            || to_char(round((CASE WHEN m.total_physical_memory_mb > 0
        THEN m.buffer_pool_mb::numeric * 100.0 / m.total_physical_memory_mb
        ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 0), 'FM999999990') || '% of physical RAM). No action needed.'
        WHEN 'OVER_PROVISIONED' THEN
            'CPU is lightly loaded (avg ' || to_char(round((c.avg_cpu_pct)::numeric, 1), 'FM999999990.0') || '%, max '
            || to_char(c.max_cpu_pct, 'FM999,999,999,990') || '%) and buffer pool uses only ' || to_char(round((CASE WHEN m.total_physical_memory_mb > 0
        THEN m.buffer_pool_mb::numeric * 100.0 / m.total_physical_memory_mb
        ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 0), 'FM999999990')
            || '% of physical RAM. This server may have more resources than it needs.'
        WHEN 'UNDER_PROVISIONED' THEN
            CASE WHEN c.p95_cpu_pct > 85
                THEN 'CPU p95 is ' || to_char(round((c.p95_cpu_pct)::numeric, 1), 'FM999999990.0')
                     || '% (threshold: 85%). This server may need more CPU capacity.'
                ELSE 'Buffer pool uses ' || to_char(round((CASE WHEN m.total_physical_memory_mb > 0
        THEN m.buffer_pool_mb::numeric * 100.0 / m.total_physical_memory_mb
        ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 0), 'FM999999990')
                     || '% of physical RAM and memory ratio is ' || to_char(round((COALESCE(m.memory_ratio, 0))::numeric, 2), 'FM999999990.00')
                     || ' (threshold: 0.95). Memory pressure is high.'
            END
        ELSE ''
    END AS "Why",
    round(c.avg_cpu_pct, 2) AS "Avg CPU %",
    round(c.p95_cpu_pct, 2) AS "P95 CPU %",
    c.max_cpu_pct AS "Max CPU %",
    s.cpu_count AS "CPUs",
    to_char(m.current_workers_count, 'FM999,999,999,990') || ' / ' || to_char(m.max_workers_count, 'FM999,999,999,990') AS "Workers",
    c.cpu_samples AS "Samples (24h)",
    round(CASE WHEN m.total_server_memory_mb > 0
        THEN (m.total_server_memory_mb - m.buffer_pool_mb)::numeric * 100.0
             / m.total_server_memory_mb
        ELSE 0 END, 1) AS "Stolen Mem %",
    round(CASE WHEN m.total_physical_memory_mb > 0
        THEN m.buffer_pool_mb::numeric * 100.0 / m.total_physical_memory_mb
        ELSE 0 END, 1) AS "Buffer Pool %",
    round(m.memory_ratio, 2) AS "Mem Ratio",
    m.total_physical_memory_mb AS "Physical MB",
    m.target_server_memory_mb AS "Target MB",
    m.total_server_memory_mb AS "Total MB",
    m.buffer_pool_mb AS "Buffer Pool MB",
    round(CASE WHEN COALESCE(st.total_mb, 0) > 0
        THEN st.free_mb * 100.0 / st.total_mb
        ELSE 100 END, 1) AS "Storage Free %",
    b.monthly_cost AS "Budget $/mo",
    b.monthly_cost * 12 AS "Budget $/yr"
FROM cpu_stats c
JOIN mem_latest m ON m.server_id = c.server_id
LEFT JOIN server_info s ON s.server_id = c.server_id
LEFT JOIN storage st ON st.server_id = c.server_id
LEFT JOIN budget b ON b.server_id = c.server_id
JOIN config.config_monitored_servers AS srv ON srv.server_id = c.server_id
ORDER BY srv.name

WITH cpu_stats AS (
    SELECT server_id,
           AVG(sqlserver_cpu_utilization::numeric) AS avg_cpu_pct,
           MAX(sqlserver_cpu_utilization) AS max_cpu_pct,
           PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sqlserver_cpu_utilization)::numeric
               AS p95_cpu_pct,
           COUNT(*) AS cpu_samples
    FROM collect.v_cpu_utilization_stats
    WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv}) AND collection_time >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '24 hours'
    GROUP BY server_id
),
mem_latest AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (server_id)
           server_id,
           total_server_memory_mb,
           target_server_memory_mb,
           total_physical_memory_mb,
           buffer_pool_mb,
           max_workers_count,
           current_workers_count,
           total_server_memory_mb::numeric / NULLIF(target_server_memory_mb, 0)
               AS memory_ratio
    FROM collect.v_memory_stats
    WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv})
    ORDER BY server_id, collection_time DESC
),
server_info AS (
    /* vcore_count is the licensable number where the platform bills by vCore. */
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (server_id)
           server_id, COALESCE(vcore_count, cpu_count) AS cpu_count
    FROM collect.server_properties
    WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv})
    ORDER BY server_id, collection_time DESC
),
storage AS (
    SELECT server_id,
           SUM(total_size_mb) AS total_mb,
           SUM(CASE WHEN used_size_mb IS NOT NULL
                    THEN total_size_mb - used_size_mb ELSE 0 END) AS free_mb
    FROM collect.v_database_size_stats
    WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv}) AND (server_id, collection_time) IN (SELECT server_id, MAX(collection_time) FROM collect.v_database_size_stats WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv}) GROUP BY server_id)
    GROUP BY server_id
),
budget AS (
    SELECT server_id, COALESCE(monthly_cost_usd, 0)::numeric AS monthly_cost
    FROM config.config_monitored_servers
    WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv})
)
SELECT
    srv.name AS "Server",
    replace(CASE
        WHEN c.avg_cpu_pct < 15 AND c.max_cpu_pct < 40 AND COALESCE(m.memory_ratio, 0) < 0.5
        THEN 'OVER_PROVISIONED'
        WHEN c.p95_cpu_pct > 85 OR COALESCE(m.memory_ratio, 0) > 0.95
        THEN 'UNDER_PROVISIONED'
        ELSE 'RIGHT_SIZED'
    END, '_', ' ') AS "Status",
    trunc((CASE
        WHEN c.p95_cpu_pct <= 70 THEN trunc(100 - c.p95_cpu_pct * 50 / 70.0)
        ELSE trunc(GREATEST(0, 50 - (c.p95_cpu_pct - 70) * 50 / 30.0))
    END) * 0.40 + (CASE
        WHEN CASE WHEN m.total_physical_memory_mb > 0 THEN m.buffer_pool_mb::numeric / m.total_physical_memory_mb ELSE 0 END <= 0.30 THEN 60
        WHEN CASE WHEN m.total_physical_memory_mb > 0 THEN m.buffer_pool_mb::numeric / m.total_physical_memory_mb ELSE 0 END <= 0.85 THEN 100
        WHEN CASE WHEN m.total_physical_memory_mb > 0 THEN m.buffer_pool_mb::numeric / m.total_physical_memory_mb ELSE 0 END <= 0.95 THEN trunc(100 - (CASE WHEN m.total_physical_memory_mb > 0 THEN m.buffer_pool_mb::numeric / m.total_physical_memory_mb ELSE 0 END - 0.85) * 800)
        ELSE trunc(GREATEST(0, 20 - (CASE WHEN m.total_physical_memory_mb > 0 THEN m.buffer_pool_mb::numeric / m.total_physical_memory_mb ELSE 0 END - 0.95) * 400))

        THEN st.free_mb * 100.0 / st.total_mb
        ELSE 100 END >= 30 THEN 100

        ELSE 100 END >= 10 THEN trunc(50 + (CASE WHEN COALESCE(st.total_mb, 0) > 0

        ELSE 100 END - 10) * 2.5)

        ELSE 100 END * 5)
    END) * 0.30) AS "Health",
    CASE CASE
        WHEN c.avg_cpu_pct < 15 AND c.max_cpu_pct < 40 AND COALESCE(m.memory_ratio, 0) < 0.5
        THEN 'OVER_PROVISIONED'
        WHEN c.p95_cpu_pct > 85 OR COALESCE(m.memory_ratio, 0) > 0.95
        THEN 'UNDER_PROVISIONED'
        ELSE 'RIGHT_SIZED'
    END
        WHEN 'RIGHT_SIZED' THEN
            'CPU is moderately loaded (avg ' || to_char(round((c.avg_cpu_pct)::numeric, 1), 'FM999999990.0') || '%, p95 '
            || to_char(round((c.p95_cpu_pct)::numeric, 1), 'FM999999990.0') || '%) and memory is well-utilized (buffer pool uses '
            || to_char(round((CASE WHEN m.total_physical_memory_mb > 0
        THEN m.buffer_pool_mb::numeric * 100.0 / m.total_physical_memory_mb
        ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 0), 'FM999999990') || '% of physical RAM). No action needed.'
        WHEN 'OVER_PROVISIONED' THEN
            'CPU is lightly loaded (avg ' || to_char(round((c.avg_cpu_pct)::numeric, 1), 'FM999999990.0') || '%, max '
            || to_char(c.max_cpu_pct, 'FM999,999,999,990') || '%) and buffer pool uses only ' || to_char(round((CASE WHEN m.total_physical_memory_mb > 0
        THEN m.buffer_pool_mb::numeric * 100.0 / m.total_physical_memory_mb
        ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 0), 'FM999999990')
            || '% of physical RAM. This server may have more resources than it needs.'
        WHEN 'UNDER_PROVISIONED' THEN
            CASE WHEN c.p95_cpu_pct > 85
                THEN 'CPU p95 is ' || to_char(round((c.p95_cpu_pct)::numeric, 1), 'FM999999990.0')
                     || '% (threshold: 85%). This server may need more CPU capacity.'
                ELSE 'Buffer pool uses ' || to_char(round((CASE WHEN m.total_physical_memory_mb > 0
        THEN m.buffer_pool_mb::numeric * 100.0 / m.total_physical_memory_mb
        ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 0), 'FM999999990')
                     || '% of physical RAM and memory ratio is ' || to_char(round((COALESCE(m.memory_ratio, 0))::numeric, 2), 'FM999999990.00')
                     || ' (threshold: 0.95). Memory pressure is high.'
            END
        ELSE ''

    round(c.p95_cpu_pct, 2) AS "P95 CPU %",

    s.cpu_count AS "CPUs",
    to_char(m.current_workers_count, 'FM999,999,999,990') || ' / ' || to_char(m.max_workers_count, 'FM999,999,999,990') AS "Workers",
    c.cpu_samples AS "Samples (24h)",
    round(CASE WHEN m.total_server_memory_mb > 0
        THEN (m.total_server_memory_mb - m.buffer_pool_mb)::numeric * 100.0
             / m.total_server_memory_mb
        ELSE 0 END, 1) AS "Stolen Mem %",
    round(CASE WHEN m.total_physical_memory_mb > 0
        THEN m.buffer_pool_mb::numeric * 100.0 / m.total_physical_memory_mb
        ELSE 0 END, 1) AS "Buffer Pool %",
    round(m.memory_ratio, 2) AS "Mem Ratio",
    m.total_physical_memory_mb AS "Physical MB",
    m.target_server_memory_mb AS "Target MB",
    m.total_server_memory_mb AS "Total MB",
    m.buffer_pool_mb AS "Buffer Pool MB",
    round(CASE WHEN COALESCE(st.total_mb, 0) > 0
        THEN st.free_mb * 100.0 / st.total_mb
        ELSE 100 END, 1) AS "Storage Free %",
    b.monthly_cost AS "Budget $/mo",
    b.monthly_cost * 12 AS "Budget $/yr"

WITH cpu_stats AS (
    SELECT server_id,
           AVG(sqlserver_cpu_utilization::numeric) AS avg_cpu_pct,
           MAX(sqlserver_cpu_utilization) AS max_cpu_pct,
           PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sqlserver_cpu_utilization)::numeric
               AS p95_cpu_pct,
           COUNT(*) AS cpu_samples
    FROM collect.v_cpu_utilization_stats
    WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv}) AND collection_time >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '24 hours'
    GROUP BY server_id
),
mem_latest AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (server_id)
           server_id,
           total_server_memory_mb,
           target_server_memory_mb,
           total_physical_memory_mb,
           buffer_pool_mb,
           max_workers_count,
           current_workers_count,
           total_server_memory_mb::numeric / NULLIF(target_server_memory_mb, 0)
               AS memory_ratio
    FROM collect.v_memory_stats
    WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv})
    ORDER BY server_id, collection_time DESC
),
server_info AS (
    /* vcore_count is the licensable number where the platform bills by vCore. */
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (server_id)
           server_id, COALESCE(vcore_count, cpu_count) AS cpu_count
    FROM collect.server_properties
    WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv})
    ORDER BY server_id, collection_time DESC
),
storage AS (
    SELECT server_id,
           SUM(total_size_mb) AS total_mb,
           SUM(CASE WHEN used_size_mb IS NOT NULL
                    THEN total_size_mb - used_size_mb ELSE 0 END) AS free_mb
    FROM collect.v_database_size_stats
    WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv}) AND (server_id, collection_time) IN (SELECT server_id, MAX(collection_time) FROM collect.v_database_size_stats WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv}) GROUP BY server_id)
    GROUP BY server_id
),
budget AS (
    SELECT server_id, COALESCE(monthly_cost_usd, 0)::numeric AS monthly_cost
    FROM config.config_monitored_servers
    WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv})
)

        THEN 'OVER_PROVISIONED'
        WHEN c.p95_cpu_pct > 85 OR COALESCE(m.memory_ratio, 0) > 0.95
        THEN 'UNDER_PROVISIONED'
        ELSE 'RIGHT_SIZED'
    END, '_', ' ') AS "Status",
    trunc((CASE
        WHEN c.p95_cpu_pct <= 70 THEN trunc(100 - c.p95_cpu_pct * 50 / 70.0)
        ELSE trunc(GREATEST(0, 50 - (c.p95_cpu_pct - 70) * 50 / 30.0))
    END) * 0.40 + (CASE
        WHEN CASE WHEN m.total_physical_memory_mb > 0 THEN m.buffer_pool_mb::numeric / m.total_physical_memory_mb ELSE 0 END <= 0.30 THEN 60
        WHEN CASE WHEN m.total_physical_memory_mb > 0 THEN m.buffer_pool_mb::numeric / m.total_physical_memory_mb ELSE 0 END <= 0.85 THEN 100
        WHEN CASE WHEN m.total_physical_memory_mb > 0 THEN m.buffer_pool_mb::numeric / m.total_physical_memory_mb ELSE 0 END <= 0.95 THEN trunc(100 - (CASE WHEN m.total_physical_memory_mb > 0 THEN m.buffer_pool_mb::numeric / m.total_physical_memory_mb ELSE 0 END - 0.85) * 800)

            || to_char(round((c.p95_cpu_pct)::numeric, 1), 'FM999999990.0') || '%) and memory is well-utilized (buffer pool uses '
            || to_char(round((CASE WHEN m.total_physical_memory_mb > 0
        THEN m.buffer_pool_mb::numeric * 100.0 / m.total_physical_memory_mb
        ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 0), 'FM999999990') || '% of physical RAM). No action needed.'
        WHEN 'OVER_PROVISIONED' THEN
            'CPU is lightly loaded (avg ' || to_char(round((c.avg_cpu_pct)::numeric, 1), 'FM999999990.0') || '%, max '
            || to_char(c.max_cpu_pct, 'FM999,999,999,990') || '%) and buffer pool uses only ' || to_char(round((CASE WHEN m.total_physical_memory_mb > 0
        THEN m.buffer_pool_mb::numeric * 100.0 / m.total_physical_memory_mb
        ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 0), 'FM999999990')
            || '% of physical RAM. This server may have more resources than it needs.'
        WHEN 'UNDER_PROVISIONED' THEN
            CASE WHEN c.p95_cpu_pct > 85

                     || '% (threshold: 85%). This server may need more CPU capacity.'

        ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 0), 'FM999999990')
                     || '% of physical RAM and memory ratio is ' || to_char(round((COALESCE(m.memory_ratio, 0))::numeric, 2), 'FM999999990.00')
                     || ' (threshold: 0.95). Memory pressure is high.'
            END

    s.cpu_count AS "CPUs",
    to_char(m.current_workers_count, 'FM999,999,999,990') || ' / ' || to_char(m.max_workers_count, 'FM999,999,999,990') AS "Workers",
    c.cpu_samples AS "Samples (24h)",
    round(CASE WHEN m.total_server_memory_mb > 0
        THEN (m.total_server_memory_mb - m.buffer_pool_mb)::numeric * 100.0
             / m.total_server_memory_mb
        ELSE 0 END, 1) AS "Stolen Mem %",
    round(CASE WHEN m.total_physical_memory_mb > 0
        THEN m.buffer_pool_mb::numeric * 100.0 / m.total_physical_memory_mb
        ELSE 0 END, 1) AS "Buffer Pool %",
    round(m.memory_ratio, 2) AS "Mem Ratio",
    m.total_physical_memory_mb AS "Physical MB",
    m.target_server_memory_mb AS "Target MB",
    m.total_server_memory_mb AS "Total MB",
    m.buffer_pool_mb AS "Buffer Pool MB",
    round(CASE WHEN COALESCE(st.total_mb, 0) > 0
        THEN st.free_mb * 100.0 / st.total_mb
        ELSE 100 END, 1) AS "Storage Free %",
    b.monthly_cost AS "Budget $/mo",
    b.monthly_cost * 12 AS "Budget $/yr"

SELECT
    "Server", "CPUs", "Workers", "Samples (24h)", "Mem Ratio",
    "Physical MB", "Target MB", "Total MB", "Buffer Pool MB",
    "Budget $/mo", "Budget $/yr"
FROM (
WITH cpu_stats AS (
    SELECT server_id,
           AVG(sqlserver_cpu_utilization::numeric) AS avg_cpu_pct,
           MAX(sqlserver_cpu_utilization) AS max_cpu_pct,
           PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sqlserver_cpu_utilization)::numeric
               AS p95_cpu_pct,
           COUNT(*) AS cpu_samples
    FROM collect.v_cpu_utilization_stats
    WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv}) AND collection_time >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '24 hours'
    GROUP BY server_id
),
mem_latest AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (server_id)
           server_id,
           total_server_memory_mb,
           target_server_memory_mb,
           total_physical_memory_mb,
           buffer_pool_mb,
           max_workers_count,
           current_workers_count,
           total_server_memory_mb::numeric / NULLIF(target_server_memory_mb, 0)
               AS memory_ratio
    FROM collect.v_memory_stats
    WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv})
    ORDER BY server_id, collection_time DESC
),
server_info AS (
    /* vcore_count is the licensable number where the platform bills by vCore. */
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (server_id)
           server_id, COALESCE(vcore_count, cpu_count) AS cpu_count
    FROM collect.server_properties
    WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv})
    ORDER BY server_id, collection_time DESC
),
storage AS (
    SELECT server_id,
           SUM(total_size_mb) AS total_mb,
           SUM(CASE WHEN used_size_mb IS NOT NULL
                    THEN total_size_mb - used_size_mb ELSE 0 END) AS free_mb
    FROM collect.v_database_size_stats
    WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv}) AND (server_id, collection_time) IN (SELECT server_id, MAX(collection_time) FROM collect.v_database_size_stats WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv}) GROUP BY server_id)
    GROUP BY server_id
),
budget AS (
    SELECT server_id, COALESCE(monthly_cost_usd, 0)::numeric AS monthly_cost
    FROM config.config_monitored_servers
    WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv})
)
SELECT
    srv.name AS "Server",
    replace(CASE
        WHEN c.avg_cpu_pct < 15 AND c.max_cpu_pct < 40 AND COALESCE(m.memory_ratio, 0) < 0.5
        THEN 'OVER_PROVISIONED'
        WHEN c.p95_cpu_pct > 85 OR COALESCE(m.memory_ratio, 0) > 0.95
        THEN 'UNDER_PROVISIONED'
        ELSE 'RIGHT_SIZED'
    END, '_', ' ') AS "Status",
    trunc((CASE
        WHEN c.p95_cpu_pct <= 70 THEN trunc(100 - c.p95_cpu_pct * 50 / 70.0)
        ELSE trunc(GREATEST(0, 50 - (c.p95_cpu_pct - 70) * 50 / 30.0))
    END) * 0.40 + (CASE
        WHEN CASE WHEN m.total_physical_memory_mb > 0 THEN m.buffer_pool_mb::numeric / m.total_physical_memory_mb ELSE 0 END <= 0.30 THEN 60
        WHEN CASE WHEN m.total_physical_memory_mb > 0 THEN m.buffer_pool_mb::numeric / m.total_physical_memory_mb ELSE 0 END <= 0.85 THEN 100
        WHEN CASE WHEN m.total_physical_memory_mb > 0 THEN m.buffer_pool_mb::numeric / m.total_physical_memory_mb ELSE 0 END <= 0.95 THEN trunc(100 - (CASE WHEN m.total_physical_memory_mb > 0 THEN m.buffer_pool_mb::numeric / m.total_physical_memory_mb ELSE 0 END - 0.85) * 800)
        ELSE trunc(GREATEST(0, 20 - (CASE WHEN m.total_physical_memory_mb > 0 THEN m.buffer_pool_mb::numeric / m.total_physical_memory_mb ELSE 0 END - 0.95) * 400))
    END) * 0.30 + (CASE
        WHEN CASE WHEN COALESCE(st.total_mb, 0) > 0
        THEN st.free_mb * 100.0 / st.total_mb
        ELSE 100 END >= 30 THEN 100
        WHEN CASE WHEN COALESCE(st.total_mb, 0) > 0
        THEN st.free_mb * 100.0 / st.total_mb
        ELSE 100 END >= 10 THEN trunc(50 + (CASE WHEN COALESCE(st.total_mb, 0) > 0
        THEN st.free_mb * 100.0 / st.total_mb
        ELSE 100 END - 10) * 2.5)
        ELSE trunc(CASE WHEN COALESCE(st.total_mb, 0) > 0
        THEN st.free_mb * 100.0 / st.total_mb
        ELSE 100 END * 5)
    END) * 0.30) AS "Health",
    CASE CASE
        WHEN c.avg_cpu_pct < 15 AND c.max_cpu_pct < 40 AND COALESCE(m.memory_ratio, 0) < 0.5
        THEN 'OVER_PROVISIONED'
        WHEN c.p95_cpu_pct > 85 OR COALESCE(m.memory_ratio, 0) > 0.95
        THEN 'UNDER_PROVISIONED'
        ELSE 'RIGHT_SIZED'
    END
        WHEN 'RIGHT_SIZED' THEN
            'CPU is moderately loaded (avg ' || to_char(round((c.avg_cpu_pct)::numeric, 1), 'FM999999990.0') || '%, p95 '
            || to_char(round((c.p95_cpu_pct)::numeric, 1), 'FM999999990.0') || '%) and memory is well-utilized (buffer pool uses '
            || to_char(round((CASE WHEN m.total_physical_memory_mb > 0
        THEN m.buffer_pool_mb::numeric * 100.0 / m.total_physical_memory_mb
        ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 0), 'FM999999990') || '% of physical RAM). No action needed.'
        WHEN 'OVER_PROVISIONED' THEN
            'CPU is lightly loaded (avg ' || to_char(round((c.avg_cpu_pct)::numeric, 1), 'FM999999990.0') || '%, max '
            || to_char(c.max_cpu_pct, 'FM999,999,999,990') || '%) and buffer pool uses only ' || to_char(round((CASE WHEN m.total_physical_memory_mb > 0
        THEN m.buffer_pool_mb::numeric * 100.0 / m.total_physical_memory_mb
        ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 0), 'FM999999990')
            || '% of physical RAM. This server may have more resources than it needs.'
        WHEN 'UNDER_PROVISIONED' THEN
            CASE WHEN c.p95_cpu_pct > 85
                THEN 'CPU p95 is ' || to_char(round((c.p95_cpu_pct)::numeric, 1), 'FM999999990.0')
                     || '% (threshold: 85%). This server may need more CPU capacity.'
                ELSE 'Buffer pool uses ' || to_char(round((CASE WHEN m.total_physical_memory_mb > 0
        THEN m.buffer_pool_mb::numeric * 100.0 / m.total_physical_memory_mb
        ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 0), 'FM999999990')
                     || '% of physical RAM and memory ratio is ' || to_char(round((COALESCE(m.memory_ratio, 0))::numeric, 2), 'FM999999990.00')
                     || ' (threshold: 0.95). Memory pressure is high.'
            END
        ELSE ''
    END AS "Why",
    round(c.avg_cpu_pct, 2) AS "Avg CPU %",
    round(c.p95_cpu_pct, 2) AS "P95 CPU %",
    c.max_cpu_pct AS "Max CPU %",
    s.cpu_count AS "CPUs",
    to_char(m.current_workers_count, 'FM999,999,999,990') || ' / ' || to_char(m.max_workers_count, 'FM999,999,999,990') AS "Workers",
    c.cpu_samples AS "Samples (24h)",
    round(CASE WHEN m.total_server_memory_mb > 0
        THEN (m.total_server_memory_mb - m.buffer_pool_mb)::numeric * 100.0
             / m.total_server_memory_mb
        ELSE 0 END, 1) AS "Stolen Mem %",
    round(CASE WHEN m.total_physical_memory_mb > 0
        THEN m.buffer_pool_mb::numeric * 100.0 / m.total_physical_memory_mb
        ELSE 0 END, 1) AS "Buffer Pool %",
    round(m.memory_ratio, 2) AS "Mem Ratio",
    m.total_physical_memory_mb AS "Physical MB",
    m.target_server_memory_mb AS "Target MB",
    m.total_server_memory_mb AS "Total MB",
    m.buffer_pool_mb AS "Buffer Pool MB",
    round(CASE WHEN COALESCE(st.total_mb, 0) > 0
        THEN st.free_mb * 100.0 / st.total_mb
        ELSE 100 END, 1) AS "Storage Free %",
    b.monthly_cost AS "Budget $/mo",
    b.monthly_cost * 12 AS "Budget $/yr"
FROM cpu_stats c
JOIN mem_latest m ON m.server_id = c.server_id
LEFT JOIN server_info s ON s.server_id = c.server_id
LEFT JOIN storage st ON st.server_id = c.server_id
LEFT JOIN budget b ON b.server_id = c.server_id
JOIN config.config_monitored_servers AS srv ON srv.server_id = c.server_id

) AS hourly_tier WHERE (CASE WHEN $__timeFrom() >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '3 days' THEN 'raw' WHEN $__timeFrom() < (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '3 days' AND $__timeFrom() >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '20 days' THEN CASE WHEN (SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_db_hourly) <= $__timeFrom() THEN 'hourly' WHEN (SELECT min(collection_time) FROM collect.v_query_stats) < COALESCE((SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_db_hourly), 'infinity'::timestamp) THEN 'raw' ELSE 'hourly' END WHEN $__timeFrom() < (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '20 days' THEN CASE WHEN (SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_db_daily) <= $__timeFrom() THEN 'daily' WHEN (SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_db_hourly) < COALESCE((SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_db_daily), 'infinity'::timestamp) AND (SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_db_hourly) <= $__timeFrom() THEN 'hourly' WHEN (SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_db_hourly) < COALESCE((SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_db_daily), 'infinity'::timestamp) AND (SELECT min(collection_time) FROM collect.v_query_stats) < COALESCE((SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_db_hourly), 'infinity'::timestamp) THEN 'raw' WHEN (SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_db_hourly) < COALESCE((SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_db_daily), 'infinity'::timestamp) THEN 'hourly' WHEN (SELECT min(collection_time) FROM collect.v_query_stats) < COALESCE((SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_db_daily), 'infinity'::timestamp) THEN 'raw' ELSE 'daily' END END) = 'hourly'
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM (
WITH workload AS (
    SELECT server_id, database_name,
           SUM(delta_worker_time) / 1000.0 AS cpu_time_ms,
           SUM(delta_logical_reads) AS logical_reads,
           SUM(delta_physical_reads) AS physical_reads,
           SUM(delta_logical_writes) AS logical_writes,
           SUM(delta_execution_count) AS execution_count
    FROM collect.v_query_stats
    WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv})
      AND $__timeFilter(collection_time)
      AND delta_worker_time IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY server_id, database_name
),
io AS (
    SELECT server_id, database_name,
           SUM(delta_read_bytes) / 1048576.0 AS io_read_mb,
           SUM(delta_write_bytes) / 1048576.0 AS io_write_mb,
           SUM(delta_stall_read_ms + delta_stall_write_ms) AS io_stall_ms
    FROM collect.v_file_io_stats
    WHERE server_id IN (${server:csv})
      AND $__timeFilter(collection_time)
      AND delta_read_bytes IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY server_id, database_name
),
combined AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.server_id, i.server_id) AS server_id,
           COALESCE(w.database_name, i.database_name) AS database_name,
           COALESCE(w.cpu_time_ms, 0) AS cpu_time_ms,
           COALESCE(w.logical_reads, 0) AS logical_reads,
           COALESCE(w.physical_reads, 0) AS physical_reads,
           COALESCE(w.logical_writes, 0) AS logical_writes,
           COALESCE(w.execution_count, 0) AS execution_count,
           COALESCE(i.io_read_mb, 0) AS io_read_mb,
           COALESCE(i.io_write_mb, 0) AS io_write_mb,
           COALESCE(i.io_stall_ms, 0) AS io_stall_ms
    FROM workload w
    FULL JOIN io i ON i.server_id = w.server_id AND i.database_name = w.database_name
),
totals AS (
    SELECT server_id,
           NULLIF(SUM(cpu_time_ms), 0) AS total_cpu,
           NULLIF(SUM(io_read_mb + io_write_mb), 0) AS total_io
    FROM combined
    GROUP BY server_id
)
SELECT
    c.server_id,
    c.database_name,
    c.cpu_time_ms,
    c.logical_reads,
    c.physical_reads,
    c.logical_writes,
    c.execution_count,
    c.io_read_mb,
    c.io_write_mb,
    c.io_stall_ms,
    c.cpu_time_ms * 100.0 / t.total_cpu AS pct_cpu_share,
    (c.io_read_mb + c.io_write_mb) * 100.0 / t.total_io AS pct_io_share
FROM combined c
JOIN totals t ON t.server_id = c.server_id
WHERE c.database_name IS NOT NULL
) AS raw_tier WHERE (CASE WHEN $__timeFrom() >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '3 days' THEN 'raw' WHEN $__timeFrom() < (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '3 days' AND $__timeFrom() >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '20 days' THEN CASE WHEN (SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_db_hourly) <= $__timeFrom() THEN 'hourly' WHEN (SELECT min(collection_time) FROM collect.v_query_stats) < COALESCE((SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_db_hourly), 'infinity'::timestamp) THEN 'raw' ELSE 'hourly' END WHEN $__timeFrom() < (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - INTERVAL '20 days' THEN CASE WHEN (SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_db_daily) <= $__timeFrom() THEN 'daily' WHEN (SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_db_hourly) < COALESCE((SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_db_daily), 'infinity'::timestamp) AND (SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_db_hourly) <= $__timeFrom() THEN 'hourly' WHEN (SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_db_hourly) < COALESCE((SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_db_daily), 'infinity'::timestamp) AND (SELECT min(collection_time) FROM collect.v_query_stats) < COALESCE((SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_db_hourly), 'infinity'::timestamp) THEN 'raw' WHEN (SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_db_hourly) < COALESCE((SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_db_daily), 'infinity'::timestamp) THEN 'hourly' WHEN (SELECT min(collection_time) FROM collect.v_query_stats) < COALESCE((SELECT min(bucket) FROM collect.query_stats_db_daily), 'infinity'::timestamp) THEN 'raw' ELSE 'daily' END END) = 'raw')
SELECT
    srv.name AS "Server",
    u.database_name AS "Database",
    round(u.cpu_time_ms, 0) AS "CPU Time (ms)",
    round(u.pct_cpu_share, 1) AS "CPU %",
    u.logical_reads AS "Logical Reads",
    u.physical_reads AS "Physical Reads",
    u.logical_writes AS "Logical Writes",
    u.execution_count AS "Executions",
    round(u.io_read_mb, 2) AS "IO Read MB",
    round(u.io_write_mb, 2) AS "IO Write MB",
    round(u.pct_io_share, 1) AS "IO %",
    u.io_stall_ms AS "IO Stall (ms)"
FROM u
JOIN config.config_monitored_servers AS srv ON srv.server_id = u.server_id
ORDER BY u.cpu_time_ms DESC
